notes: Partial encoding: Alaska Growth Hormone criteria Version 3; approved 4/29/2016; PDF effective 10/3/2016; last updated 4/17/2026. Stub effective_date 2026-01-01 retained for updated PDF.

Initial approval only. Nine closed diagnoses; all-request denials apply to all. SHOX does not cite Table 1. No invented numeric age or specialty gates. Path selects attest all constituent conditions; first-met ordering makes overlapping clinical branches mutually exclusive selections without changing eligibility.

Pediatric GHD approval nesting: growth failure + additional pituitary deficiencies OR growth failure + hypothalamic/pituitary surgery/irradiation OR ((velocity ≥2 SD below mean OR (height ≥2 SD below mean AND velocity >1 SD below mean)) AND (two subnormal stimulation tests OR one subnormal test + low IGF-1)). Open epiphyses and exclusion of other causes apply to every path.

SGA initial approval height wording (<2 SD below mean) is retained verbatim, not silently corrected. Reauthorization height wording and pediatric GHD/CKD height approval-versus-denial inconsistencies require manual source review.
Reauthorization SHOX, Noonan and Turner (notes only): approve pediatric patients not at final adult height or completed linear growth; deny at final adult height or completed linear growth.

Reauthorization Prader-Willi (notes only): BMI <35 kg/m², no severe respiratory impairment or untreated severe OSA, and not at final adult height/completed linear growth. Deny final height/completed growth, BMI ≥35, or severe respiratory impairment/untreated severe OSA.

Reauthorization CKD (notes only): no kidney transplant, previous GH ≤3 years, not attained mid-parental target height OR height not within 3rd percentile of normal adult height (65 inches boys/60 inches girls), and open epiphyses. Deny transplant, previous GH >3 years, attained mid-parental height OR height within that adult-height percentile, closed epiphyses, or final adult height/completed linear growth.

Reauthorization SGA (notes only): born SGA (birth weight or length ≥2 SD below gestational-age mean), height has not caught up to being <2 SD below age/gender mean, and pediatric patient not at final adult height/completed linear growth. Deny not born SGA, height caught up to <2 SD below mean, or final adult height/completed growth.

Reauthorization pediatric GHD (notes only): open epiphyses; pre-treatment growth rate doubled OR increased ≥3 cm/year in first treatment year OR growth rate ≥2.5 cm/year beyond first year; has not yet achieved mid-parental height OR height is within 3rd percentile normal adult height (65 inches boys/60 inches girls), as printed. Deny bone age =16 years males or =14 females, closed epiphyses, growth rate <2.5 cm/year past year, or whichever occurs sooner: reached mid-parental height OR height within 3rd percentile adult height. Mid-parental height = (father’s height + mother’s height)/2, plus 2.5 inches males or minus 2.5 inches females. Conflicting approval/denial height wording is not resolved into predicates.

Reauthorization transition and adult GHD (notes only): yearly clinical assessment evaluating adverse effects, IGF-1 and other GH-response parameters; assessment indicates response and continued need. Deny absent yearly assessment/evaluation, lack of response, or no continued need.
Initial coverage up to 6 months; reauthorization up to 12 months. Quantity limit: None. Duration and all reauthorization criteria require manual review.

FDA matrix and Table 1 are reference notes only, not hard product predicates. Zorbtive is FDA-labeled for short bowel syndrome but Alaska explicitly denies SBS; ISS is likewise denied despite some FDA labels. Skytrofa is lonapegsomatropin-tcgd within this class PDF. Alternatives empty: Serostim HIV wasting is outside this closed diagnosis list and is not an interchangeable covered indication.
